name: Lenia Lifeforms
desc: Bert Chan's Lenia — a continuous cellular automaton whose smooth ring-kernel convolution and Gaussian growth breed glowing orbium-like creatures that glide, pulse, split and self-organize across the field; renders as bioluminescent deep-sea blooms, thermal, green cell-membrane, magenta plasma, or dark sumi ink on cream.

density.doc: how many seed colonies spawn (more = fuller frame)
